mostWorthwhile.text: Load-testing the operating link was most worthwhile: comparing measured loads with usable capacity established an overnight margin rather than just assuming the batteries would last.

leastWorthwhile.text: My attempt to use Moth before the link was tested gave no helpful next-step information, making it the least productive decision.

surprise.text: The protected batteries needed solar inputs before the radios could be connected, although the panels would contribute nothing that night.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the solar inputs before connecting the radios felt somewhat arbitrary for an overnight test, even though the later explanation made their daytime purpose clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the two neighborhoods make their networks understand each other; Tin Row's call provides a concrete next problem.
